scientific.integrity: The period-two family is obtained by solving the exact source Lion recurrence under alternating signs. The sign inequalities give a necessary-and-sufficient band, and the transverse spectrum follows from the exact two-step affine Jacobian.
limitations: Zero decoupled weight decay and constant learning rate.
Boundary states with zero sign input are excluded.
The theorem gives a local period-two family and transverse behavior, not a global basin classification.

title: Exact chattering band and transverse spectrum of constant-step Lion
